verses.en: Do ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?
verses.pt: Falais deveras o que é reto, vós os poderosos? Julgais retamente, ó filhos dos homens?
verses.en_web: Do you indeed speak righteousness, silent ones? Do you judge blamelessly, you sons of men?
verses.en_bbe: <To the chief music-maker; put to Al-tashheth. Michtam. Of David.> Is there righteousness in your mouths, O you gods? are you upright judges, O you sons of men?

verses.en: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.
verses.pt: Não, antes no coração forjais iniqüidade; sobre a terra fazeis pesar a violência das vossas mãos.
verses.en_web: No, in your heart you plot injustice. You measure out the violence of your hands in the earth.
verses.en_bbe: The purposes of your hearts are evil; your hands are full of cruel doings on the earth.

verses.en: The wicked are estranged from the womb: they go astray as soon as they be born, speaking lies.
verses.pt: Alienam-se os ímpios desde a madre; andam errados desde que nasceram, proferindo mentiras.
verses.en_web: The wicked go astray from the womb. They are wayward as soon as they are born, speaking lies.
verses.en_bbe: The evil-doers are strange from the first; from the hour of their birth they go out of the true way, saying false words.

verses.en: Their poison is like the poison of a serpent: they are like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear;
verses.pt: Têm veneno semelhante ao veneno da serpente; são como a víbora surda, que tapa os seus ouvidos,
verses.en_web: Their poison is like the poison of a snake; like a deaf cobra that stops its ear,
verses.en_bbe: Their poison is like the poison of a snake; they are like the adder, whose ears are shut;

verses.en: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.
verses.pt: de sorte que não ouve a voz dos encantadores, nem mesmo do encantador perito em encantamento.
verses.en_web: which doesn’t listen to the voice of charmers, no matter how skillful the charmer may be.
verses.en_bbe: Who will not be moved by the voice of the wonder-worker, however great are his powers.

verses.en: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O LORD.
verses.pt: Ó Deus, quebra-lhes os dentes na sua boca; arranca, Senhor, os caninos aos filhos dos leões.
verses.en_web: Break their teeth, God, in their mouth. Break out the great teeth of the young lions, Yahweh.
verses.en_bbe: O God, let their teeth be broken in their mouths; let the great teeth of the young lions be pulled out, O Lord.

verses.en: Let them melt away as waters which run continually: when he bendeth his bow to shoot his arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.
verses.pt: Sumam-se como águas que se escoam; sejam pisados e murcham como a relva macia.
verses.en_web: Let them vanish like water that flows away. When they draw the bow, let their arrows be made blunt.
verses.en_bbe: Let them be turned to liquid like the ever-flowing waters; let them be cut off like the grass by the way.

verses.en: As a snail which melteth, let every one of them pass away: like the untimely birth of a woman, that they may not see the sun.
verses.pt: Sejam como a lesma que se derrete e se vai; como o aborto de mulher, que nunca viu o sol.
verses.en_web: Let them be like a snail which melts and passes away, like the stillborn child, who has not seen the sun.
verses.en_bbe: Let them be like an after-birth which is turned to water and comes to an end; like the fruit of a woman who gives birth before her time, let them not see the sun.

verses.en: Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind, both living, and in his wrath.
verses.pt: Que ele arrebate os espinheiros antes que cheguem a aquecer as vossas panelas, assim os verdes, como os que estão ardendo.
verses.en_web: Before your pots can feel the heat of the thorns, he will sweep away the green and the burning alike.
verses.en_bbe: Before they are conscious of it, let them be cut down like thorns; let a strong wind take them away like waste growth.

verses.en: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.
verses.pt: O justo se alegrará quando vir a vingança; lavará os seus pés no sangue do ímpio.
verses.en_web: The righteous shall rejoice when he sees the vengeance. He shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked;
verses.en_bbe: The upright man will be glad when he sees their punishment; his feet will be washed in the blood of the evil-doer.

verses.en: So that a man shall say, Verily there is a reward for the righteous: verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth.
verses.pt: Então dirão os homens: Deveras há uma recompensa para o justo; deveras há um Deus que julga na terra.
verses.en_web: so that men shall say, “Most certainly there is a reward for the righteous. Most certainly there is a God who judges the earth.”
verses.en_bbe: So that men will say, Truly there is a reward for righteousness; truly there is a God who is judge on the earth.
